latest.title: AWS MCP Server: which one to use, when, and how to set it up (now that AWS recommends just one)
latest.description: Two things carry the AWS MCP name and they solve different problems. This breaks down Knowledge MCP versus the managed AWS MCP Server, when each one earns its place, and the IAM side that most setup guides skip. Includes working configuration for Claude Code, the Claude desktop app, and Kiro, with credentials handled properly instead of a key pasted into .env. Written after AWS consolidated its recommendation around a single server.

latest.description: Learn how to construct role-based system prompts and explicit negative constraints in Amazon Bedrock to automatically turn chaotic sprint notes into structured technical documentation.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: LIFE RPG — Turn Your Life Into a Game with AI
latest.description: LIFE RPG is an AI-powered creative app that turns your real-life goals, strengths, weaknesses, and role into a personalized RPG character. It uses Grok AI to generate characters, stats, quests, bosses, XP, levels, and achievements, with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, and DynamoDB powering the serverless application.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: CoreCheck.exe
latest.description: an unhinged ai fashion roast machine that grades your fit, measures your vibe, and tells you if you ate or are completely cooked.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: Prompt Roulette
latest.description: Pull the lever and see what you get: Prompt Roulette is a spin-the-wheel creative generator that rolls a random category (haiku, meme caption, plot twist, band name, villain line, weird invention) plus a rarity tier, then prints your result as a vintage carnival ticket stub. Built entirely on AWS's Always-Free tier -- Lambda, Lambda Function URLs, and DynamoDB -- with zero external LLM calls, plus a public gallery for saving and upvoting your favorite pulls.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: Lumina AI — Imagine It, Create It, Play It
latest.description: Meet Lumina AI — a creative AI workspace that turns imagination into something you can create, explore, and play. Generate stories and poems, brainstorm visual ideas, build game concepts, write playable game code, and iterate on your creations with multiple AI models. Deployed with AWS Amplify.

latest.title: Building a Leaderboard That Doesn't Fall Over: Write-Sharding and Scatter-Gather in DynamoDB
latest.description: A deep dive into designing a DynamoDB leaderboard that survives 1,000+ writes per second while staying instantly rankable — using write-sharding to spread the load and scatter-gather reads to put it back together. Covers the deterministic shard-assignment trick, the score-encoding scheme, and the trade-offs that come with the design.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: Dream Weaver
latest.description: An AI app that turns your dreams into a symbolic interpretation and a piece of generated art, built with Amazon Bedrock's Nova Lite and Stable Image Core models.

latest.title: Testes unitários: como parar de testar código e começar a testar comportamento
latest.description: Aprenda a pensar em testes unitários além da sintaxe. Neste artigo, uso Go para explicar casos de sucesso e erro, Table Driven Tests, TDD e como testar regras de negócio com uma visão voltada para Engenheiro de Software

latest.title: Build a False-Positive reporting experience with AWS WAF
latest.description: Learn how to build a user-friendly false-positive reporting mechanism with AWS WAF. Using managed rule labels, custom responses, dynamic label interpolation, and AWS WAF CAPTCHA, you can provide users with useful request details and a secure way to report legitimate requests that were incorrectly blocked, making it easier for security teams to investigate and resolve false positives.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: MoodMuse
latest.description: Whisper a mood or scene, get back a poem and a painting made just for it. Built solo over one weekend, running entirely on Amazon Bedrock.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: Flux Studio
latest.description: I am a painter who spent the weekend building a machine that paints: a browser-based generative poster studio with four drawing modes, reproducible seeds, and print-resolution export. It is my first project deployed on AWS.

latest.title: I Added 6 Languages to My Quiz App. Zero Scoring Changes
latest.description: How I added on-the-fly translation (Amazon Bedrock) and Arabic RTL support to my AWS certification quiz app without touching the scoring engine.

latest.title: Weekend Creative Challenge: AI Transformation Playbook
latest.description: Pitch an AI initiative to four executives who object out loud, in character. Pick a market and an industry, or paste a document and let the app work them out. The same pitch meets a completely different room in Singapore, Tokyo or Jakarta. You leave with a score, the three questions you are least ready for, and the objections read aloud. Built on AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Polly.
